steps.content: The battle ends quickly. A bewildered Hella stares at the sand beast corpses strewn around outside.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: ...Holy cow! This is way cooler than the desert bandits' cannons...

Unlike the cannons captured by the desert bandits, the ones on the OAB ship are clearly superior in both accuracy and firepower. The sand ship shimmers with a faint blue light—even the Hypercube shielding system is much stronger than two years ago.
In short... a formidable team, and a valuable potential ally.
As for her other ally...
Hella gulps nervously, looking at the comms device she was given. She tried calling ${PlayerName} just now...—busy signal, no answer.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: That dummy... always nagging me, but not around when I finally call home? What's the big idea...
She has no choice but try to text them.
Upon logging in to her account, an unexpected wave of unread messages floods in like a tide.

<color=#fb9259>Hecate</color>: Hella, it's me, Hecate.

<color=#fb9259>Hecate</color>: Chief gave me a new comms device and said I could reach you with it... but the signal in WhiteSands is bad. Not sure when this message will get you.
<color=#fb9259>Hecate</color>: Don't know how far you've gone now... Have you gotten stronger? Did you come upon any dangers? Have you caused trouble for the Legion?

<color=#fb9259>Hecate</color>: You got this.
<color=#fb9259>Hecate</color>: I'm waiting for you to come back.
Hecate's messages went on for months, the most recent one just a couple of days ago..
...Since when did she become so mushy?
At the end of the message is a photo of a blue-haired girl typing seriously on a comms device. Judging by the angle, it seems to be a candid shot.
She types out a request for help, hesitates for a moment, then deletes it and logs out.
Revenge, after all, is something one has to take oneself.
She turns and sees Scotch close by, having waited for a long time.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Alright, let's talk. What kind of collaboration are you talking about?
The brief exchange of information ends. Scotch lowers his head, deep in thought.

steps.speaker: Scotch
steps.content: I see. So you met some roaming outlaws as well. They stir up just as much trouble as the desert bandits.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: What do you mean? You guys got screwed over by those bastards too?

steps.speaker: Scotch
steps.content: No, they're very cunning and never directly engage with official personnel. Fortunately, you escaped safely. Many have been tricked and abducted to the Outlands, never to be heard from again...

Swindling, cheating, abducting... According to Scotch, the people of Tuco have committed every kind of crime. Not only do they loot and plunder, but they also take pleasure in harming passersby. Truly despicable.

steps.speaker: Scotch
steps.content: Moreover, they've also targeted <color=#fb9259>Hypercubes</color>.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: ...Huh?

steps.speaker: Scotch
steps.content: Nirvana recently lost a very important shipment. The climate in WhiteSands has been changing rapidly. Disasters are worsening, and many city-states are relying on this shipment for survival. The demand for Hypercubes was already greater than the supply, and now the gap is even larger.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Hypercubes...

steps.speaker: Korryn
steps.content: The desert bandits chasing you just stole someone else's Hypercube, but they didn't keep an eye on it. Now they're taking it out on you, thinking you're the thief who stole their loot.

steps.speaker: Korryn
steps.content: Just a bit of... luggage we borrowed from the bandits?
So that big box contains the stolen Hypercubes after all! The desert bandits first robbed the Hypercubes from Nirvana, then Korryn stole them from the desert bandits.

steps.speaker: Scotch
steps.content: That group is very cautious. They flee at the sight of any patrol ship, making it difficult to locate their hideout.

steps.speaker: Scotch
steps.content: That's why we wanted to collaborate with the MBCC... but it seems that your Chief is too busy to do so this time.
${PlayerName} clearly doesn't have time. He's not even answering his phone. He's definitely handling other matters.
steps.female_content: ${PlayerName} clearly doesn't have time. She's not even answering her phone. She's definitely handling other matters.

steps.content: However...
Hella clears her throat, drawing back Scotch's attention.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Ahem. Don’t bother trying to contact that dummy. He’s indeed very busy. But, collaborating with the MBCC isn’t entirely impossible.
steps.female_content: Ahem. Don’t bother trying to contact that dummy. She’s indeed very busy. But, collaborating with the MBCC isn’t entirely impossible.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Isn't there someone who just escaped from Tuco right in front of you?

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: To Korryn, I'm just a loser. Those bastards avoid you, but they sure as hell don't hide from me. They're always trying to trick me into joining them.

steps.speaker: Scotch
steps.content: The Outlanders like Sinners. They probably see your value.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: ...Hmph... That's perfect, then. I'll deliver myself right to them.
Perhaps it's true. Her mind races like never before. A plan is gradually taking shape.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Bring it on, Tuco chumps! Let's see who screws over who this time!
